"Of course we are air-gapped."
Six ways the air gap is already broken: a vendor laptop on Wi-Fi, a USB stick from the office, a hidden cellular modem, a PC on both networks, an undocumented cable, a wireless sensor gateway.
Any one of them ends the air gap. How many are in your building? Security you can prove.

Cameras, routers and controllers ship with a factory login. If nobody changed it, anyone who finds the device online can log in as you.
Ten-minute fix: check your CCTV recorder, router and building control panel today.

Multi-factor authentication adds a second check at login: an app on your phone or a security key. A phished password alone no longer gets them in.
Myth: a strong password is enough.

You typed your code. So did they.
A fake login page passes your password and one-time code to the real site, then keeps your logged-in session.
Phishing-resistant MFA, like passkeys or security keys, stops it. So does checking the address before you log in.
